content.name: Fiona Ashworth
content.title: Head of Product
content.summary: Head of product with 16 years in telecoms, property, pensions and energy. Lead six product managers at a Leeds-based renewable energy supplier, where the smart tariff app we launched grew to 180,000 active users and cut customer service contacts by a fifth. Started as a business analyst and still enjoys getting close to customer problems before committing a roadmap.

experience.title: Head of Product
bullets: Lead a product team of six PMs and two designers across customer app, billing and smart tariffs, reporting to the COO.
Launched a time-of-use tariff app that reached 180,000 active users and shifted 11% of evening peak demand for enrolled homes.
Cut customer service contacts by 20% by prioritising self-serve meter readings, payment plans and moving home.
Introduced quarterly outcome-based planning, replacing feature lists with three measurable goals per team.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Owned the member web and app experience for 600,000 workplace pension savers.
Shipped a pension consolidation journey that brought in £310m of transferred assets in its first 18 months.
Worked with compliance to meet FCA communication rules while simplifying retirement options screens.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Built the lettings agent dashboard used by 2,300 branches to manage listings and leads.
Introduced lead quality scoring that improved agent response rates by 15%.
Ran the first A/B testing programme on search results, with 40 experiments in two years.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Gathered requirements for broadband order tracking used by 70 call centre agents.
Analysed failed installation data and proposed engineer slot changes that reduced repeat visits by 12%.
Moved into product ownership for the order tracking tool in the final year.
